description: Get one discussion topic: its prompt, author, posting rules and unread count, without the replies. Read-only. The prompt is fenced as untrusted text. Use get_full_topic_view to read the whole thread, or list_topics to find topic IDs.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

topic_id.description: Discussion topic ID (numeric string). Get it from list_topics.
